records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Truckload services revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, represented 68.6% and 68.8% of total revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, for the quarters ended September 30, 2025, and 2024, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The remaining operating revenues, before fuel surcharges, for the same periods were generated from brokerage and logistics services, representing 31.4% and 31.2%, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The truckload services division operating ratio, which measures the ratio of operating expenses, net of fuel surcharges, to operating revenues, before fuel surcharges, increased from 100.5% for the third quarter of 2024 to 106.7% for the third quarter of 2025.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating supplies and expenses increased from 11.7% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2024 to 12.6% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2025.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Non-operating income decreased from 3.3% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2024 to 2.8% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the third quarter of 2025.
